+<class name="RichTextEditToolbar" inherits="HBoxContainer" api_type="core" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="../class.xsd">
+	<brief_description>
+		Toolbar with common formatting controls for [RichTextEdit].
+	</brief_description>
+	<description>
+		[RichTextEditToolbar] provides common formatting controls for a [RichTextEdit]. It includes controls for bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, font size, foreground color, and indentation.
+		Assign [member rich_text_edit_path] to the [RichTextEdit] to format. If the path is empty, the toolbar looks for a sibling [RichTextEdit] when it enters the scene tree.
+		The font size control follows the target editor's caret position. The color picker previews changes while it is open and commits the final color as a single undoable formatting action when the popup closes.
